name: Kendo-ComfyUI-H3 Fast v2
readme: Kendo MiniMax H3 Ref2VA Turbo studio v2. Supports up to 9 image references, 1 video reference, and 3 audio references. Models and the matching Ref2VA Turbo LoRA download in parallel with resume support to /workspace on first launch. Open port 3000 for the streamlined Crimson UI or port 8188 for ComfyUI.
